title: WPMS/1933/2019 of RAFEEK AHMAD Vs CHOLA MANDALAM M. S. GENERAL INSURANCE CO. LIMITED

paras.text:
WPMS No. 1933 of 2019
Hon'ble Manoj K. Tiwari, J.
Mr. P.C. Petshali, Advocate for the
petitioner.
Mr. Sarvesh Agarwal, Advocate for
respondent.
Heard learned counsel for the parties.
Petitioner's wife sustained head injuries
in a road accident consequently she
remained hospitalized for a considerable
period of time.
A claim petition was ultimately filed on
her behalf before Motor Accident Claims
Tribunal, Udham Singh Nagar for
compensation. Pursuant to a settlement
arrived at between petitioner's wife and the
insurance company, the insurance company
deposited a sum of Rs. 5,25,000/- with the
Motor Accident Claims Tribunal.
After deposit of the said amount,
petitioner moved an application for
withdrawal of the amount. His application
has been rejected by learned Tribunal on the
ground that the lady, who was produced
before the Tribunal, could not disclose her
name. Thus, feeling aggrieved, petitioner has
approached this Court against rejection of
his withdrawal application.
Since the money deposited by the
insurance company before learned Tribunal
belongs to petitioner's wife, therefore,
petitioner had no locus standi to file
application seeking withdrawal of that
money. Learned Tribunal, therefore, rightly
rejected petitioner's application.
In such view of the matter, this Court
does not find any reason to interfere with the
impugned order.
Accordingly, the writ petition is
dismissed.

However, it shall be open to petitioner's
wife to move an application herself or
through next friend, seeking withdrawal of
the money. If such an application is made,
learned Tribunal shall pass appropriate
order thereupon in accordance with law,
having due regard to the interest of
petitioner's wife.
